records.text: Erika Kirk pulled out of the TPUSA event because of several factors, not only security concerns; if there had been security concerns, the vice president would not have gone.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1mYNOqzAdXs)

appearances.snippet: she pulled out of the TPUSA event because of a bunch of factors i don't think it was just security concerns the source said if there were security concerns the vice president wouldn't have gone

verification.notes: The episode reads an anonymous-insider account saying several factors drove the withdrawal and that security alone was not the full story. CBS separately confirms that TPUSA publicly cited threats while the Secret Service found the venue safe and Vance proceeded. The existence of competing reported explanations is supported, but the anonymous source does not independently establish Kirk actual motives or the counterfactual claim about what Vance would have done.
